## Rule

Rows or columns that are entirely background inside the active grid are recolored to color 2. All other cells are unchanged, and padded cells outside the active grid must remain zero.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
def predict(x):
    # x is one-hot [10, 30, 30]; channel 0 is background.
    nonbg = x[1:].sum(axis=0)
    row_empty = nonbg.sum(axis=1) < 0.5
    col_empty = nonbg.sum(axis=0) < 0.5

    paint = x[0] * (row_empty[:, None] | col_empty[None, :])
    out = x.copy()
    out[0] -= paint
    out[2] += paint
    return out
```

The staged ONNX implements the same update as a final polynomial `Einsum`, using marginal row/column detectors and multiplying by input channel 0 so zero padding is not painted.
